claim_checks.extract_quote: The probability of mortality for each area/year sample of post-smolts was then calculated assuming 100% mortality for smolt with more than six lice...

claim_checks.claim: VPS mortality higher than trawl in 26/27 area-year comparisons (Figure 1); especially when trawl mortality low
claim_checks.extract_quote: The estimated mortality of post-smolts caught by trawling were lower than the average of predicted mortalities for the VPS from rivers draining into the corresponding fjords for 26 out of 27 year by area comparisons.
claim_checks.note: The extract supports this claim with specific data.
